name: fee-ladder
title: Fee ladder
question: Which fee rate is actually the depositor's lever?
note: The management-capped variant (100/2000) is not a proposal in any ticket. It is here to test the finding that the MANAGEMENT rate, not the performance rate, is what the depositor should care about: management accrues on asset-seconds for every day a proposal is open, win or lose, so a fund deployed most of the year pays it in full. Note also that the '#330 reading' is a judgement call -- two of the three #330 constants no longer exist post-audit.
